## At a glance

- **Delegate with confidence** — Correctness, permission, and blast radius are held by separate mechanisms, so delegated work is verified rather than taken on trust.
- **Multiply your output** — Isolation, delegation shapes, and fleet coordination raise how much work can be in flight at once.

## Delegate with confidence

Correctness, permission, and blast radius are held by separate mechanisms, so delegated work is verified rather than taken on trust.

- **Treat done as a verdict, not a claim** — `discern done` runs the project's declared jobs by stage — format, build, lint, typecheck, test, and smoke — wakes the scope gates the change touched, and measures every standard. Work counts as finished when the project's own commands agree; an agent's confidence stays advisory. _Draws on: The quality gate · Declared jobs · format · build · lint · typecheck · test · smoke._
- **Check the claim instead of trusting the account** — A green gate over a clean, committed tree mints Proof: one line naming the exact commit, the change's size, and what was checked, backed by a full review page. A later commit or edit invalidates it, so the evidence only ever describes the tree on disk. _Draws on: Proof._ _Claims: `proof-exact-tree` (structural)._
- **Keep the evidence after the task is gone** — Landing writes the structured Proof onto the trunk commit as a durable note, so the review record outlives the worktree's cleanup and travels with the exact commit it vouches for. _Draws on: Durable proof notes._
- **Separate permission from correctness** — A green gate grants nothing. Landing needs consent in the conversation, a standing grant recorded on the trunk, or a one-shot grant made at the desk — resolved against the exact changed paths, with every uncertainty returning to the conversation. _Draws on: Landing authority is proved per invocation · Accept._ _Claims: `gate-grants-no-authority` (structural)._
- **Let routine work land, keep judgment work reviewed** — Scopes named under `[acceptance].pre_authorized` land green changes without a fresh conversation — documentation in the seeded example — while agent-instruction surfaces stay outside the grant, so a change to how future sessions behave always reaches review. _Draws on: Landing authority is proved per invocation · The desk._
- **Bound the blast radius** — Every effort runs in its own worktree, forked from the trunk; the trunk moves only by fast-forwarding an accepted branch; and supervision of other efforts stays on the owner's command line. _Draws on: Isolated worktrees · Start · Accept._ _Claims: `isolated-worktrees` (structural)._
- **Never inherit a half-finished state** — Effectful verbs plan before they apply and rehearse under `--dry-run`, provisioning records its intent before acting, and interruption leaves either a finished state or a recoverable one — never a convincing half. _Draws on: Plan and apply · Crash-safe provisioning · Clean under interruption._

## Multiply your output

Isolation, delegation shapes, and fleet coordination raise how much work can be in flight at once.

- **Take on more work** — The delegate-work playbook turns discussed work into complete, self-contained briefs for fresh agents — one handoff, a parallel fan-out, or staged programs — and `discern start` gives each one an isolated, provisioned worktree. _Draws on: Delegate work · Start._ _Claims: `shaped-delegation` (structural, demonstrated)._
- **Run a fleet on one machine** — Every worktree derives a distinct port, site, and database name, inherits the declared secrets, and provisions its declared resources; the fleet view names the files two efforts both changed. _Draws on: Deterministic identity · Per-worktree resources · Env inheritance · The fleet view._ _Claims: `no-checkout-collisions` (structural)._ _Caveat: Checkout collisions are designed out; overlapping edits to the same source files remain possible and are surfaced as fleet collisions rather than prevented._
- **Stop relaying messages between agents** — `discern await` blocks on one condition — a sibling branch green, its work landed, or the trunk moved — using the longest reliable call with a continuation that survives the gap, so a dependent agent waits on evidence instead of polling or asking a person to relay. _Draws on: Awaiting a fleet condition · Await the fleet._
- **Build on work before it lands** — `discern start` and `discern update` take a `from` ref, so a dependent effort forks from a sibling's exact proven commit while the trunk waits for `discern accept`. _Draws on: Composing unlanded work · Update._
- **Walk away mid-task** — Worktrees persist between sessions, session hooks re-ready a resumed checkout, unfinished setup stays a machine-readable state, and one `discern status` call re-orients whoever returns. _Draws on: Status · Session and lifecycle hooks · Observable incompleteness · Idempotent by contract._
- **Leave no orphaned mess** — `discern worktree prune` reclaims the resources of worktrees that vanished without a clean teardown, and ignored-file drift is reported before removal deletes work hiding outside version control. _Draws on: Orphan reclamation · Ignored-file drift._

## Quality that only improves

Quality numbers and disciplines only tighten: regression is a gate failure, not a review catch.

- **Hold numbers that move one way** — A standard's floor may only rise and its ceiling only fall, compared against the trunk's committed limit on every run — the bar cannot be loosened by the branch under pressure to pass it. _Draws on: Standards · Floors and ceilings._ _Claims: `standards-cannot-loosen` (structural)._
- **Capture a gain the moment it exists** — `discern standards --pin` tightens each improved limit to the value just measured, leaves the declared margin of headroom, and commits that change alone. _Draws on: Capturing a gain · Pin headroom._ _Claims: `pin-measured-gains` (structural)._
- **Keep standards honest as the project grows** — Rates via `per` keep a number honest as the project grows, input-keyed replay spares unrelated changes the measurement cost, on-demand measurement defers only the expensive half, any tool that prints one line can feed a standard, and a breach the work itself caused escalates to the owner instead of moving the limit. _Draws on: Rates, not raw counts · Input-keyed replay · On-demand measurement · Breach escalation · One-line metric protocol._
- **Make a fixed bug extinct** — The cure-a-bug playbook proves the cause, fixes the class, and leaves a guard driven off the single source of truth; the forcing-function discipline ties every canonical set to its satellites, so a new member cannot arrive half-wired. _Draws on: Cure a bug · Forcing-function parity · The closed set of closed sets._
- **Outlaw a legacy pattern** — The set-the-standard playbook retires a legacy pattern for good: a detector, a ceiling that only falls, then a permanent rule at zero. _Draws on: Set the standard._
- **Hold back the clutter** — The clear-the-decks playbook sweeps the clutter agent-built projects accumulate as proven-safe commits and caps what remains behind a standard, while `discern tidy` keeps discern's own prose and config surfaces from collecting format churn. _Draws on: Clear the decks · Canonical formatting for discern surfaces._
- **Keep documentation that cannot rot** — Every gate run validates the map's links, anchors, fenced commands, frontmatter, audience boundaries, and skill citations; a generated file that drifts from its sources stops the gate early; the glossary holds one name per concept; and the decision-record index maintains itself. _Draws on: The docs integrity preflight · Generated artifact declarations · Fail-fast preconditions · The vocabulary canon · Publication control._ _Claims: `map-mechanically-checked` (structural)._

## Knowledge that compounds

What one session learns, every later session — and every configured agent — inherits.

- **Teach a lesson once** — One authored guidance body compiles into every configured agent's instruction file, skills make recurring procedures one file every session can load, and the teach-the-project playbook routes a lesson into its smallest durable home. Config-aware templating keeps the compiled instructions scoped to the project they describe. _Draws on: Agent guidance · Author once, compile everywhere · Config-aware guidance · Skills · Teach the project._ _Claims: `one-guidance-source` (structural)._
- **Audit what the agents believe** — Agents maintain the map under the gate, file-linked freshness facts say which sources each page covers and when they moved, and the document-subsystem playbook refreshes a subtree from the real code — so reading the map audits what the agents understand. _Draws on: The map · File-linked freshness · Document a subsystem._
- **Keep the why behind decisions** — Decision records carry context, decision, and consequences from a canonical template, guided by the write-adr playbook, so the reasons outlive the sessions that decided them. _Draws on: Decision records · Write an ADR._
- **Meet failure knowledge at the failure** — A gotchas entry whose matcher fits the failure arrives inline in the failing result, and every registered hint fires inside the result that made it relevant — knowledge delivered at the moment it applies, remembered by nobody. _Draws on: The gotchas pointer · Registered hints._
- **Orient any session in one call** — The discovery funnel finds the right page from task language, the bundled manual answers offline, command help mirrors `--help`, and a forgiving command line turns renames and synonyms into pointers at the canonical verb. _Draws on: The discovery funnel · discern's own manual · CLI help · A forgiving command line._
- **Hand anyone a curated briefing** — `discern map --export` writes the public projection, a selection, or a named scope's pages — in their declared order — into one file: a curated briefing for a new person or a new agent. _Draws on: The map browser._
- **Inherit the practices that keep facts written once** — The write-it-once playbook carries discern's own construction discipline into any stack: one authority per shared fact, guards that enrol future members, effects planned before they run. _Draws on: Write it once._

## Freedom of movement

Nothing about the practice binds the project to one agent vendor, one stack, or to discern itself.

- **Switch providers without re-teaching the project** — Guidance, skills, map, gate, standards, and worktree practice are project-owned, and each configured provider receives its instruction file, hooks, and MCP wiring from one registry — changing agents changes a configuration list, not the project's memory. _Draws on: Agent providers · Claude Code · Codex · Gemini · Cursor · GitHub Copilot · Materialization · The Model Context Protocol (MCP) server._ _Claims: `switch-without-reteaching` (structural, demonstrated)._
- **Bring one practice to every stack** — The engine ships none of the stack's tools and runs whatever commands the project declares; every subsystem is core and the guarantees are structural, so habits, guidance, and docs transfer between projects verbatim. _Draws on: Stack-neutral · Every subsystem is core · Foundations._
- **Adopt without a leap of faith** — Setup is a staged, consent-first handshake the agent completes — installed agents detected, `[jobs]` filled by examining the repository, worktree viability proven before done is claimed. Presets fill without overwriting, the binary is self-contained, the tracked footprint is one root file, and discern develops under its own gate. _Draws on: Install and lifecycle · Agent-driven setup · Ready-to-relay messages · Detection at setup · Presets · A one-file footprint · One self-contained binary · Run on itself._ _Claims: `installs-a-practice` (structural, demonstrated); `no-manual-configuration` (structural, demonstrated); `setup-proves-worktree` (structural, demonstrated); `one-config-file` (structural); `runs-on-itself` (demonstrated, observational)._ _Caveat: Dogfooding is internal evidence: discern's own use of discern demonstrates the practice, and independent external validation stays separate._
- **Leave as cheaply as you came** — `discern uninstall` reverses the wiring from the ownership registry and keeps `discern.toml`, guidance, map, skills, and scripts as plain files at the paths the project chose. _Draws on: Uninstall · File ownership._
- **Upgrade on your own schedule** — The binary never checks the network or updates itself. `discern upgrade` migrates configuration idempotently and validates before stamping, and `discern doctor` verifies the install and names each fix. _Draws on: Upgrade and migrations · Doctor._

## Attention where it matters

The person's reading, and the agent's context, go to judgment instead of mechanics.

- **Review the judgment, not the mechanics** — Work arrives with the gate passed and Proof pinned to the exact tree, so human reading concentrates on intent, design, and the decision to ship. _Draws on: The quality gate · Proof · Standards._ _Claims: `reduced-review-burden` (demonstrated, observational)._ _Caveat: An observational claim: founder-experienced rather than independently measured, and the right review depth stays a function of project risk and the owner's confidence in the configured practice._
- **Supervise the fleet from one screen** — Bare `discern` opens the desk: every effort grouped by the decision it needs, only valid actions offered, each action echoing its command-line equivalent — and one deterministic tip per session teaches the next capability. _Draws on: The desk · Desk tips._
- **Fail forward, fast** — `discern prepare` is the sub-minute loop; fail-fast cancellation, time budgets, and the capture environment keep a red gate short; strand detection stops a proof-eligible run at the first stranded file; diagnostics carry the file, line, and reproducing command; an unchanged tree refuses a rerun, so a flake becomes a recorded probe instead of a retry habit; and the write preflight spends a few filesystem operations instead of a discarded run. `discern test` runs the suite without the rest, and live streaming watches a slow job. _Draws on: The fast inner loop · Tests on their own · The staged pipeline · Fail-fast cancellation · Job time budgets · The capture environment · Live or grouped output · Strand detection · Normalized diagnostics · A rerun on an unchanged tree is attested · Write authority proven first._
- **Hear about the file you forgot** — `discern coupling` mines the project's own history for the habitual partners missing from a change — self-calibrating, evidence attached, surfaced while the change is still open. _Draws on: Coupling._
- **Pay only for what changed** — Scopes classify each change and wake only the affected gates, `discern impact` answers which scopes woke, and untouched standards replay their recorded measurements. Classification fails open: a mistake adds checks, never removes them. _Draws on: Scopes · Fail-open classification · Impact · Input-keyed replay._
- **See how the practice is actually going** — `discern patterns` turns the metadata-only logbook into counted findings and a shareable stats card, `discern improvement` ranks the next action with its evidence, and agent cohorts appear as counts beside denominators — compared, never ranked. _Draws on: Patterns · Improvement · The logbook._ _Claims: `patterns-compare-cohorts` (structural, demonstrated)._
- **Spend agent context on the work** — Every surface an agent reads is designed for that reader: results sized for a context window, discovery starting from region names instead of an index, a curated and budget-held skill set, and advisories arriving inside results already being read. _Draws on: The agent is the user · Context is a budget · A curated bundled set · Advisories and the logbook._ _Claims: `agent-as-operator` (structural)._

## Sovereignty

The practice runs on the owner's machine, under the owner's consent, on contracts the owner can build against.

- **Keep everything on the machine** — discern contains no model, needs no key, and makes no network calls — a gate test keeps network interfaces out of its code path. The logbook holds metadata only, never leaves the machine, and has a real off switch. _Draws on: No model inside · Evidence stays local · The logbook._ _Claims: `no-model-inside` (structural); `local-logbook` (structural)._
- **Make consent structural** — Destructive verbs refuse read-only until consent lands in the transcript, and discern writes only where placement licenses it — an architectural test enforces the boundary. _Draws on: Placement is consent._
- **Build your own tooling on the contracts** — One result envelope backs the human rendering, `--json`, and the MCP tools alike; schemas and TypeScript declarations publish from the build; project scripts receive the environment contract; terminal output honors automation conventions; and `discern licenses` answers compliance offline. _Draws on: Interfaces and contracts · One result envelope · Published contracts · Project scripts · Terminal discipline · Config without a parser · Licenses and notices._
